description: Public devnet Network Profile. Contains only public configuration: the Arcium cluster offset, the default free RPC, and the deployed Walnut program id. No private endpoint, key, or paid provider is referenced. See docs/DEVNET_DEPLOY.md for the deploy and benchmark runbook.

rpc.note: Free, keyless public devnet RPC. Rate-limited; a large program deploy may need retries or any standard Solana JSON-RPC alternative. Override with ANCHOR_PROVIDER_URL / the --rpc flag. No paid RPC is required.

arcium.note: Shared Arcium devnet cluster offset. Cluster PDAs (cluster, computation, mempool, executing pool) derive from this offset; MXE and comp-def PDAs derive from the program id.

program.note: Matches declare_id! in programs/walnut/src/lib.rs and the Anchor.toml [programs.localnet] id. Deploying with the persisted target/deploy/walnut-keypair.json keeps the devnet program id identical to the declared id.
